label: GO step early in the episode, after an unrewarded trial or when choosing a2
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.3% of mass; never when in_rew=1 at D1, nearly never at D2). Within GO it is an early-episode unit: rate 68% on trial 0, 24% on trials 0-9, falling steadily to zero after trial ~60. Inside that window it prefers GO steps after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward=0, 80% of mass) and steps where the agent chooses a2 (model_act=2, 83% of mass; choice logit strongly negative). The strongest activations are runs of unrewarded a2 choices in the first trials of an episode, and the activation decays across consecutive rewarded trials. Recorded predicate: GO & ep_trial<40 & prev_reward==0, OR GO & ep_trial<20 & model_act==2 (dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.93). It uses only observed history plus the agent own choice (model_act at GO), with no future variables. GO alone has recall 0.99 but precision 0.14. Main false positives are GO steps after an unrewarded a1 trial that followed a rewarded a1 streak. The unit looks like a slowly decaying early-episode / uncertainty signal biased toward a2, so the time cutoffs are approximations of a graded variable.
